entries.title: Proverbs 13:1
segments: ¶A wise son [heareth] his father's instruction; but a scorner heareth not rebuke.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:2
segments: ¶A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth; but the soul of the treacherous, violence.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:3
segments: ¶He that guardeth his mouth keepeth his soul; destruction shall be to him that openeth wide his lips.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:4
segments: ¶A sluggard's soul desireth and hath nothing; but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:5
segments: ¶A righteous [man] hateth lying; but the wicked maketh himself odious and cometh to shame.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:6
segments: ¶Righteousness preserveth him that is perfect in the way; but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:7
segments: ¶There is that feigneth himself rich, and hath nothing; there is that maketh himself poor, and hath great wealth.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:8
segments: ¶The ransom of a man's life is his riches; but the indigent heareth not rebuke.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:9
segments: ¶The light of the righteous rejoiceth; but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:10
segments: ¶By pride there only cometh contention; but with the well-advised is wisdom.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:11
segments: ¶Wealth [gotten] by vanity diminisheth; but he that gathereth by manual-labour shall increase [it].

entries.title: Proverbs 13:12
segments: ¶Hope deferred maketh the heart sick; but the desire [that] cometh to pass is a tree of life.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:13
segments: ¶Whoso despiseth the word shall be held by it; but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:14
segments: ¶The teaching of the wise [man] is a fountain of life, to turn away from the snares of death.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:15
segments: ¶Good understanding procureth favour; but the way of the treacherous is hard.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:16
segments: ¶Every prudent [man] acteth with knowledge; but the foolish layeth open [his] folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:17
segments: ¶A wicked messenger falleth into evil; but a faithful ambassador is health.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:18
segments: ¶Poverty and shame shall be [to] him that refuseth instruction; but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:19
segments: ¶The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul; but it is abomination to the foolish to depart from evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:20
segments: ¶He that walketh with wise [men] becometh wise; but a companion of the foolish will be depraved.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:21
segments: ¶Evil pursueth sinners; but to the righteous good shall be repaid.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:22
segments: ¶A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children's children; but the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the righteous [man].

entries.title: Proverbs 13:23
segments: ¶Much food is in the tillage of the poor; but there is that is lost for want of judgment.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:24
segments: ¶He that spareth his rod hateth his son; but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:25
segments: ¶The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul; but the belly of the wicked shall want.
